sources.entry: Redis Desktop Manager - Cross-platform open source database management tool for Redis ®

summary.one_liner: A GUI client for browsing and managing Redis databases, formerly named RedisDesktopManager and now being renamed RESP.app.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and only announces that the project is now called RESP.app (formerly RedisDesktopManager) and is joining forces with Redis. It links to a blog post and an FAQ for details, but it does not describe features, supported platforms, or how to use the tool. The repository metadata and the awesome-list entry describe it as a cross-platform open source database management tool for Redis. Beyond that, no capabilities are documented in the README.
use_cases: browse Redis keys and values through a graphical interface
manage a Redis database without the command line
notable: Joined forces with Redis, per the README announcement
Cross-platform according to the awesome-list description
caveats: README is a short announcement only; installation and feature details are not documented in it
Name and branding changed, so older RedisDesktopManager references may be outdated
